text:
Maya: Quick sync on the in-panel docs consistency work. I'm trialing an "alias bridge" UI: under the panel header show the Console label + a single-line "also called" alias row that links to docs. Want to align UX and avoid duplicate terms in search.

Jin: Love the bridge idea. One-line alias keeps the UI clean. Can we make the alias clickable to jump to the canonical doc?

Priya: Yes but accessibility: clickable aliases need focus and an aria-label like "Open canonical doc for <term>". Also keyboard users should be able to cycle through aliases.

Lee: Accessibility + semantics: use aria-current on the currently visible doc and ensure the alias row is hidden from SR when empty. Add a skip link from the header to the TOC.

Maya: Implementation note: alias data comes from docs manifest: preferred_label, aliases[], deprecated flag. Fallback: if no aliases, show nothing. Example snippet: 
```
preferred_label: "Model routing"
aliases: ["routing", "model-sharding"]
deprecated: false
```

Jin: For discoverability, show only the top alias and a small ellipsis menu for additional variants. Clicking the ellipsis expands a list with copy-to-clipboard for search terms.

Priya: Microcopy suggestion: use the phrase "Also known as:" (screen-reader: "aliases"). For deprecated docs show "Deprecated" badge + aria-disabled on alias links.

Maya: UX question: should we mirror the docs lexicon in the panel headings or keep Console terms and show aliases underneath?

Jin: Mirror docs lexicon in headings if slugs are stable. Otherwise console-first with aliases is safer. Docs team: can you guarantee slug stability? @docs-bot

docs-bot: Running slug stability check now and will post results to #docs-api. Also I can emit a CSV mapping console_label -> preferred_label -> aliases within 24h.

Lee: Telemetry: track alias clicks, ellipsis opens, and reports via a small feedback link "Wrong term? Tell us". Add A/B test that shows headings as docs-lexicon vs console-lexicon.

Maya: Rollout plan: prototype in Figma tomorrow, canary to 7% for 48h with a11y checklist. If metrics look good, broaden rollout and schedule a docs glossary import job.

Priya: One more: ensure color contrast for alias row and that truncated alias text shows full term on hover.

Maya: Thanks all, will post the prototype + a11y demo link when ready.
